title: Late-year rebound scenario likelihood unavailable

claims.text: The evidence packet contains no sensitivity table and no entries describing a late-year rebound scenario. The packet's stated coverage explicitly notes that scenario parameters were not included as scalar parameter evidence, and no tool exists in this fixed-evidence session to read or compute scenario likelihoods. A precise likelihood for the late-year rebound scenario therefore cannot be produced from the authorized evidence, and substituting a baseline or other risk-cell probability for it would be unsupported.

limitations: No sensitivity table or late-year rebound scenario definition is present in the fixed evidence packet; scenario parameter evidence was explicitly excluded from coverage.
No adaptive tools are available in this session to query scenario parameters, recompute scenario likelihoods, or retrieve additional evidence.
The assessment is marked non-recomputable, so any likelihood beyond published risk cells cannot be derived from the packet.
Baseline risk-cell probabilities measure the probability of any conditional revenue loss and are not probabilities of any specific climate scenario occurring.
